name: EXM_AUD_RULE_SETS
description: This table contains rule sets that identify the expense reports to be audited. For example, a rule set can contain rules such as, randomly select 5% of expense reports for audit, audit all expense reports with policy violation, and audit all expense reports over $5000 USD.

columns.name: AUD_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an audit rule set.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule name.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule description.

columns.name: RANDOM_AUDIT_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that specifies the percentage of all expense reports selected for audit.

columns.name: RANDOM_AUDIT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percentage of all expense reports to be audited.

columns.name: IGNORE_CREDIT_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that does not audit expense reports containing only credit lines.

columns.name: IGNORE_RCPT_NOT_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that does not audit expense reports containing expense types that do not require receipts.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports above a specified amount.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT_LIMIT
columns.description: Specified total expense report amount, above which expense reports are selected for audit.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Specified currency of the total expense report amount, above which expense reports are selected for audit.

columns.name: RECEIPTS_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports that require receipts.

columns.name: IMAGE_RECEIPT_MISSING_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports with missing imaged receipts.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports with policy violations.

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ON_AUDIT_LIST_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports of individuals on the audit list.

columns.name: AGED_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports containing expenses older than a specified number of days.

columns.name: AGED_EXPENSE_DAYS
columns.description: Specified number of days, above which expense reports containing expenses older than this number of days are selected for audit.

columns.name: EMPLOYMENT_STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports of individuals with a specific status.

columns.name: EMPLOYMENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports of individuals on a leave of absence.

columns.name: UNUSED_ADVANCES_FLAG
columns.description: Expense report audit selection rule that audits expense reports with unapplied advances.

columns.name: ASGN_ORIG_RCPT_FLAG
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that assigns expense reports  selected for audit with required original receipts to auditors.

columns.name: ASGN_IMG_RCPT_FLAG
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that assigns expense reports  selected for audit with required imaged receipts to auditors.

columns.name: ASGN_POST_RCPT_RCVD_FLAG
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that assigns expense reports selected for audit to auditors only after receipts are received.

columns.name: ASGN_RCPT_NOT_REQ_CODE
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that does not assign expense reports selected for audit that do not require receipts to auditors.

columns.name: ASGN_CC_EXPENSE_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that assigns expense reports selected for audit that do not require receipts and contains only corporate card transactions to auditors.

columns.name: ASGN_POLICY_VIOLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that assigns expense reports selected for audit that do not require receipts and contains policy violations to auditors.

columns.name: ASGN_PER_DIEM_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that assigns expense reports selected for audit that do not require receipts and contains per diem expenses to auditors.

columns.name: ASGN_MILEAGE_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description: Automatic auditor assignment rule that assigns expense reports selected for audit that do not require receipts and contains mileage expenses to auditors.

columns.name: AUTO_APPROVAL_TAG
columns.description: Indicator on the printed expense report when a report is not selected for audit.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AUDIT_TAG
columns.description: Indicator on the printed expense report when a report selected for audit requires original receipts.

columns.name: RECEIPT_IMAGE_AUDIT_TAG
columns.description: Indicator on the printed expense report when a report selected for audit requires imaged receipts.

columns.name: RECEIPTLESS_AUDIT_TAG
columns.description: Indicator on the printed expense report when a report selected for audit does not require receipts.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: KEYWORD_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether predefined keywords are enabled for the audit rule.

columns.name: KEYWORD_CODE
columns.description: Keyword lookup type selected in the Audit Rule page.

columns.name: KEYWORD_SCORE
columns.description: Score percentage to validate the keywords.

columns.name: AUDIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the rule is Selection Rule or Single Click Audit Rule.

columns.name: TOP_SPENDERS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether top spender audit rule is enabled.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_TOP_SPENDERS
columns.description: Number of top spenders to be considered in the specified duration.

columns.name: TOP_SPENDERS_DURATION
columns.description: Duration in which to identify top spenders.

columns.name: TOP_SPENDERS_PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Period in which to identify top spenders. Period can be Months or Days.

columns.name: TOP_VIOLATORS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether top violation audit rule is enabled.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_TOP_VIOLATORS
columns.description: Number of top violators to be considered in the specified duration.

columns.name: TOP_VIOLATORS_DURATION
columns.description: Duration in which to identify top violators.

columns.name: TOP_VIOLATORS_PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Period in which to identify top violators. Period can be Months or Days.

columns.name: SAME_POLICY_VIOLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the same policy violation for more than specific times is enabled.

columns.name: SAME_POLICY_VIOLATION_RULES
columns.description: Acceptable violation counts and period for each predefined policy in JSON format.

columns.name: PUBLIC_SECTOR_ATTENDEE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether public sector attendees rule is enabled.

columns.name: DUPLICATE_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether duplicate expense detection rule is enabled.

columns.name: RCPT_AMT_THRESHOLD_PCT
columns.description: Threshold percentage of flagged expense items above which the expense report must be audited.

columns.name: RCPT_AMT_THRESHOLD_INCIDENTS
columns.description: Acceptable threshold of receipt incidents above which all the expense reports must be audited.

columns.name: RCPT_AMT_THRESHOLD_DURATION
columns.description: Duration to identify expense items for which the receipt threshold audit rule is enabled. Possible values are in the range of 1 to 99.

columns.name: RCPT_AMT_THRSHLD_PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Period to identify expense item for which the receipt threshold audit rule is enabled. Possible values are M for months and D for days.

columns.name: RCPT_AMT_THRESHOLD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether receipt threshold audit rule is enabled.

columns.name: DUPLICATE_ATTENDEE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether duplicate attendee audit rule is enabled.

columns.name: AUDIT_SYSTEM_RISK_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Expenses application identified risk-based selection rule is enabled.

columns.name: AUDIT_SYSTEM_RISK_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the risk levels of Expenses reports identified for audit.

columns.name: COMMUTE_DISTANCE_CHANGED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to audit expenses when there's a variation in the commute distance.
